# VitraCare: full context

> VitraCare, window film installation in Brussels: custom window film and tint for private homeowners and tenants (houses and flats), in Brussels and its surroundings. Privacy (mirror effect or matte white film), summer comfort (solar film), UV protection against fading and added security (anti-burglary film). Free quote, reply within 24 hours.

VitraCare acts as a commercial intermediary: first contact, advice and the quote are handled by VitraCare, and installation is carried out by our collaborator, an independent installer. VitraCare remains the client's single point of contact before and after the work. Based in Brussels, Belgium. Trilingual site: French (default), Dutch (/nl) and English (/en).

Other language versions: [Français](https://vitracare.be/llms-full.txt) · [Nederlands](https://vitracare.be/nl/llms-full.txt)

## The 4 films in detail

### Mirror effect film (silver or black)
During the day, as long as it's brighter outside than inside, the film reflects light on the street side: people outside can't see in. From inside, the view stays sharp but a little darker, like wearing sunglasses, with a very slight reflection. In the evening, if the interior is lit and it's dark outside, the effect reverses and people can see in again: that's how this type of film normally works, not a fault.

Figures from the supplier's technical datasheet, for the version VitraCare installs: visible light transmission (VLT) 22%, UV rejection 72%, solar infrared rejection 81%. The infrared figure is not a percentage of total heat blocked.

The black version limits the view from outside more in the evening, with the lights on inside, at the cost of a noticeably darker room at all times.

### Solar tint
Stays transparent in both directions, with a slight blue tint. Reduces heat and glare and protects against UV. Provides no privacy. Suited to conservatories and south- or west-facing rooms.

### Matte white film (also called opaque or blackout film)
Blocks the view in both directions, day and night, while letting light through. The view is blurred from both sides. Suited to bathrooms, ground-floor bedrooms and glazed doors.

### Anti-burglary film
Transparent, with no effect on privacy. EN 356 certified (the European standard for glazing break-in resistance) and CE marked; the technical datasheet is available on request. It doesn't make the window unbreakable: on impact, the shards stay stuck to the film, which significantly slows down a break-in attempt.

### For all films
- Compatible with single, double and triple glazing, and can be combined on the same project.
- Usually installed on the interior side; exterior installation remains possible. For triple glazing, exterior installation is generally recommended.
- Estimated lifespan of 10 to 15 years when installed on the interior side. 2-year warranty on installation.
- The films are designed first and foremost against summer heat: no insulating effect is promised in winter, as it hasn't been measured for these films.

## Pricing

No prices are displayed on the site. The price is the same whichever film you choose: it depends on the glass surface to be treated and how accessible the windows are. Every project gets a personalised, free, no-obligation quote, with a reply within 24 hours.

The home measurement visit is free in Brussels; outside Brussels, the trip costs €50. You can also send your own measurements to get a quote without a visit.

## Service area

Brussels-Capital Region (19 municipalities) and its periphery, Walloon Brabant and Flemish Brabant. Elsewhere in Belgium (for example Charleroi, Antwerp or Ghent) for large enough projects.

## Frequently asked questions

**How does a quote request work?** You send your measurements and a few photos of your windows for an initial estimate, or you ask for a home measurement visit (free in Brussels, €50 outside). The quote is free and comes with no obligation.

**Do you have a showroom?** No, there's no physical showroom. The "Our work" page shows real projects.

**What warranty do you offer?** 2 years on installation. It covers a defect linked to the installation itself (peeling, a bubble caused by poor application), not damage caused afterwards by misuse or a third party.

**Who carries out the installation?** Our collaborator, an independent installer. VitraCare remains your single point of contact before and after the work.

**How can I stop neighbours or passers-by from seeing into my home?** During the day, mirror effect film stops people seeing in without closing curtains or shutters. For privacy day and night, matte white film is the alternative, at the cost of a blurred view.

**Does a transparent privacy film exist?** Yes during the day, with mirror effect film; no around the clock. At night, with the lights on inside, no film keeps both a clear view and privacy. Details: https://vitracare.be/en/blog/film-anti-regard-transparent

**Does the film protect against heat and UV?** Mirror effect film blocks 72% of UV and rejects 81% of solar infrared radiation, which reduces heat in summer. No insulating effect is promised in winter.

**Do you install on all types of glazing?** Yes: single, double and triple glazing.

**Is it legal to put film on your windows in Belgium?** Yes, for a house or a flat: as far as we know, no specific regulation prohibits residential window film. Check your co-ownership rules (mirror or matte white film is visible from the street) or the planning rules for a listed façade.

**Can film be applied to windows that are already installed?** Yes, directly on the existing glazing, with no removal or replacement, in a single visit.

**Does anti-burglary film prevent a break-in?** No, no film makes a window unbreakable. It significantly slows down an attempt by keeping the shards stuck to the film.

**How do I clean a window with film on it?** With water and mild soap only, without chemical cleaners (ammonia, alcohol). Don't clean or touch the window for the month following installation, so the film can fully adhere.

**Replace your windows or install film?** Replacement is more complete (insulation) but significantly more expensive and disruptive. Film is applied to existing windows, with no major work: it makes sense when the windows are in good condition and the need is privacy, heat or security.
